# Kovi
> Kovi is daily vehicle walkaround check software for UK fleets. Drivers scan a QR code on the vehicle, complete the check on their phone and report defects with photos. Offices see every check, defect and missed vehicle live. £1 per vehicle per week, 30 day free trial with no card.

- [Features](https://kovifleet.co.uk/features): QR code checks, defect photos, offline mode, MOT and service reminders, trailer checks and weekly reports. Everything a fleet needs for daily vehicle checks.
- [QR code vehicle checks](https://kovifleet.co.uk/features/qr-code-vehicle-checks): Stick a QR code in the cab. Drivers scan it with their phone camera and the right check for that vehicle opens straight away. No app download, no searching.
- [Defect reporting with photos](https://kovifleet.co.uk/features/defect-reporting-with-photos): Drivers report a defect with a note and a photo. The office is emailed straight away, assigns a fix and closes it off. Full history kept for every vehicle.
- [Works with no signal](https://kovifleet.co.uk/features/offline-vehicle-checks): Depots, yards and farms have dead spots. Kovi saves the check on the phone and sends it when the signal comes back. Nothing is lost.
- [MOT, tax and service reminders](https://kovifleet.co.uk/features/mot-tax-and-service-reminders): Add MOT, tax and service dates once. Kovi emails you before anything runs out, so no vehicle is caught out on the road.
- [Tractor and trailer checks](https://kovifleet.co.uk/features/tractor-and-trailer-checks): Check the tractor unit and the trailer in one go. Each gets its own record and defects stay with the right vehicle.
- [Custom checklists](https://kovifleet.co.uk/features/custom-vehicle-check-templates): Build the checks your vehicles need. Tick items, number readings, photo items and different checks for different vehicle types.
- [Reports and history](https://kovifleet.co.uk/features/vehicle-check-reports-and-history): Every check ever done, searchable by vehicle, driver and date. Weekly PDF report by email and PDF for any check. Ready when someone asks.
- [Who it's for](https://kovifleet.co.uk/industries): Kovi works for HGV and haulage fleets, van fleets, plant hire, construction, waste and skip hire, courier firms and vehicle hire.
- [HGV and haulage](https://kovifleet.co.uk/industries/hgv-and-haulage-fleets): Daily HGV walkaround checks, tractor and trailer, defect photos and a record the transport office can find. £1 per vehicle per week.
- [Van fleets](https://kovifleet.co.uk/industries/van-fleets): Simple daily van checks on a phone. Defects reported with photos, MOT and service dates tracked, and every check on record. From £1 a van a week.
- [Plant hire and construction](https://kovifleet.co.uk/industries/plant-hire-and-construction): Pre-use checks for diggers, dumpers, telehandlers and site vehicles. Works offline on site, with photos and a record by machine.
- [Waste and skip hire](https://kovifleet.co.uk/industries/waste-and-skip-hire): Daily walkaround checks for skip lorries, RCVs and roll-on roll-off vehicles. Defect photos, hydraulics checks and records by vehicle.
- [Courier and delivery](https://kovifleet.co.uk/industries/courier-and-delivery-firms): Quick daily checks for van drivers and owner drivers. PIN login, no app download, alerts for defects and missed checks.
- [Vehicle and trailer hire](https://kovifleet.co.uk/industries/vehicle-and-trailer-hire): Record vehicle condition with photos every time it goes out and comes back. Settle damage disputes with evidence.
- [Agriculture and farms](https://kovifleet.co.uk/industries/agriculture-and-farm-vehicles): Tractors, telehandlers and farm vehicles checked before use. Works with poor signal in the yard and in the field.
- [Guides](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides): Plain English guides to daily walkaround checks, checklists, defect reporting, record keeping and choosing software, written for UK fleet operators and drivers.
- [HGV walkaround check guide](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/hgv-walkaround-check-guide): What to check on an HGV before every journey: cab, tyres, lights, leaks, load and trailer. A step by step walkaround with what to record and report.
- [Daily vehicle check checklist](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/daily-vehicle-check-checklist-uk): A practical daily vehicle check checklist for lorries and large vehicles in the UK. Copy it onto paper or build it in Kovi as a template.
- [Van daily check checklist](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/van-daily-check-checklist): A quick daily check list for vans: lights, tyres, fluids, load and documents. Takes two minutes. Copy it or use it as a Kovi template.
- [How long to keep check records](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/how-long-to-keep-walkaround-check-records): Operators are expected to keep driver check and defect records for a set period. What DVSA guidance says, what to keep and how to find it later.
- [Driver defect reporting guide](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/driver-defect-reporting-guide): What to write when you find a defect, who to tell, when to stop the vehicle and how operators should record and close it off.
- [PMI vs daily walkaround check](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/pmi-vs-daily-walkaround-check): Planned preventive maintenance inspections and daily driver checks do different jobs. Here is how they fit together for UK operators.
- [Trailer walkaround check guide](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/trailer-walkaround-check-guide): How to check a trailer before you set off: coupling, air lines, landing legs, lights, tyres and load. Includes common faults.
- [Tyre checks for lorries and vans](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/tyre-checks-for-lorries-and-vans): Tread, pressure, damage and age: what a driver can check on a tyre in thirty seconds, and when to stop and report it.
- [Rolling out daily checks to drivers](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/how-to-roll-out-daily-checks-to-drivers): Why drivers skip checks and how to fix it: make it quick, make it matter, show you read them and never punish honest defect reports.
- [How to choose a vehicle check app](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/how-to-choose-a-vehicle-check-app): A buyer checklist for fleet check software: price, offline use, defect workflow, records, data export and what happens if you leave.
- [Common walkaround check mistakes](https://kovifleet.co.uk/guides/common-walkaround-check-mistakes): Tick and flick, undated sheets, defects never closed. The mistakes that make a check worthless, and simple fixes for each.
- [Pricing](https://kovifleet.co.uk/pricing): Simple vehicle check software pricing. £1 per vehicle per week, every feature included, unlimited drivers, no contract and no card for the 30 day trial.
- [How it works](https://kovifleet.co.uk/how-it-works): See how drivers complete a vehicle check in a minute, how defects reach the office, and how to be set up in five minutes.
- [FAQ](https://kovifleet.co.uk/faq): Answers on the free trial, pricing, drivers, offline use, data, security and cancelling.
- [About](https://kovifleet.co.uk/about): Kovi makes daily vehicle checks quick for drivers and clear for the office. Built in Scotland with a working lorry firm. £1 per vehicle per week.
- [Contact](https://kovifleet.co.uk/contact): Questions about Kovi, pricing or your free trial? Get in touch by email.
- [Security and data](https://kovifleet.co.uk/security): UK data hosting, encrypted connections, hashed passwords, login lockouts, audit log and owner-controlled export and deletion.
- [Paper vs digital checks](https://kovifleet.co.uk/compare/paper-vs-digital-vehicle-checks): Paper check sheets against a phone app: cost, speed, proof, reporting and record keeping. An honest comparison for UK fleets.
- [Spreadsheets vs software](https://kovifleet.co.uk/compare/spreadsheets-vs-vehicle-check-software): Using Excel or Google Sheets for vehicle checks? Where it works, where it breaks and when to move to dedicated software.
